title: Surreal Ocean Eye
description: A surreal black-background illustration features a giant stylized white eye with a swirling galaxy pupil at its center. A palm tree with exposed roots grows from the eye, while a bearded man sits on a sea turtle surrounded by purple coral, fish, a large whale, and flowing purple and pink underwater elements.
prompt: Surreal black and purple illustration of a giant stylized eye with a swirling galaxy as its iris, white sclera with visible blood vessels. A palm tree with long exposed roots grows out from the top of the eye. A bearded man sits cross-legged on a large sea turtle. Surrounding them are a purple whale, various fish, pink coral, underwater vines and flowers, all floating in a cosmic underwater dreamscape with stars and nebulae.
